channel.description: Latest articles from Your Next Shoes (yournextshoes.com)

item.title: Pointed-Toe Pumps Dominate the 91st NYFCC Awards: See the Best (and Most Predictable) Red Carpet Shoes
item.description: From Lupita Nyong’o’s bold Alice + Olivia red velvet suit to Rose Byrne’s elegant Carolina Herrera, see every red carpet look from the 91st New York Film Critics Circle Awards. We break down the footwear trends, from ubiquitous pointed-toe pumps to Gaby Hoffmann’s standout orange velvet platforms.

item.title: Sophie Turner Goes 'Office Siren' in Self-Portrait & Black Suede Studio for Steal
item.description: Sophie Turner channels "Office Siren" style for her new Prime Video series, Steal. Discover her polished press tour looks featuring Self-Portrait tailoring and the must-have Black Suede Studio "Shania" mules.

item.title: Sadie Sink Proves Pointed-Toe Pumps Are the Ultimate Partner for Wide-Leg Jeans
item.description: Sadie Sink masters off-duty style by pairing casual denim with rare archival 2001 Dolce & Gabbana safety-pin pumps and modern Prada slingbacks. See how the Stranger Things star uses statement footwear to transform simple jeans during her NYC press tour.

item.title: How Kiernan Shipka Uses Valentino Platforms to Style Her 5'2" Frame for Industry Press Tour
item.description: Discover how Kiernan Shipka mastered "Industry" Season 4 press style. From sky-high Valentino "Tan-Go" platforms to whimsical Thom Browne wingtip pumps, we break down her designer footwear choices and how she styles mini skirts for her petite 5'2" frame.

item.title: Crystal Straps & Lacquer Silk: The Best Shoes and Red Carpet Looks at the 2026 WWD Style Awards
item.description: See what Hailey Bieber, Paris Hilton, and Mindy Kaling wore to the 2026 WWD Style Awards! Get the details on Hailey’s vintage Armani tribute, Paris’s leopard-print drama, and the sparkling Louboutins that stole the show on the red carpet.

item.title: Helen Mirren Wears Russell & Bromley Pearlqueen Biker Boots to High Noon Premiere
item.description: Discover the details behind Dame Helen Mirren’s Russell & Bromley “Pearlqueen” biker boots. See how the 80-year-old icon styled these pearl-trimmed leather boots with a houndstooth maxi dress for the High Noon opening night in London.

item.title: 2026 Astra Film Awards: Minimalist Heels Dominate the Red Carpet on Amanda Seyfried, Elle Fanning, and Sofia Carson
item.description: See the best shoes from the 2026 Astra Film Awards! We break down Elle Fanning’s silver "So Nude" sandals, Amanda Seyfried’s "Artiste" pumps, and Sofia Carson’s $9,200 Saint Laurent look. Get the details on this year's biggest footwear trends.

item.title: The Best Shoes at the 2026 Golden Globes: Every Roger Vivier, Jimmy Choo & Saint Laurent Moment
item.description: Awards season has started! Discover the 12 most striking shoe moments from the 2026 Golden Globes, featuring Jimmy Choo, Saint Laurent, and 2026's biggest trends.

item.title: Porsha Williams Debuts the "Selma" Knit Dress & Dark Macadamia Saint Laurent Pumps for WWHL
item.description: See Porsha Williams’ stunning head-to-toe brown look on WWHL. Featuring the Zuleyha Kuru Selma dress and Saint Laurent Elysée pumps in dark macadamia leather.

item.title: Wedge Mules are Trending: How Sophie Turner Styled the Look at BAFTA’s Steal
item.description: Is the wedge mule officially back? Sophie Turner stuns in $1,080 Khaite "Colt" leather mules at the BAFTA "Steal" screening. Get the look and see why these 2026-ready shoes are the season's must-have alternative to stilettos.
